_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The 0-for-34 base rate over 7 days confirms this is a tight coil where HOLD is the statistically honest call despite bullish macro divergence favoring an eventual upward resolution.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst explicitly calls HOLD direction while narrative frames a coiling resolution; judge sides with the analyst's HOLD on direction given the coil base rate, while maintaining LONG positioning on the signal
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear & Greed rises above 38, entering the Anxiety phase with conviction
next_move.invalidated_if: Fear & Greed drops below 24 into Panic, breaking the coil downward
